VaultEntry.title: VaultEntry
VaultEntry.description: A saved link, single-page folder, or expandable/collapsible layer belonging to a user's JAYTINSTORE vault.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the vault owner.

kind.description: Entry type: direct clickable link, single-page folder, or collapsible layer.

columnId.description: Column identifier where this entry lives.

parentId.description: ID of parent folder or collapsible layer, or empty string for top-level entries.

title.description: Display name of the link, folder, or layer.

url.description: Normalized http/https URL for links, or empty string for folders/layers.

isOpen.description: Expanded state for collapsible layer entries.

sortOrder.description: Numeric ordering weight within the column or parent container.

ColumnSettings.title: ColumnSettings
ColumnSettings.description: Custom headings for the three JAYTINSTORE columns.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the vault owner.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when headings were updated.

/users/{userId}/entries/{entryId}.description: Stores a user's links, folders, and collapsible layers.

/users/{userId}/meta/{settingId}.description: Stores a user's customized column headings (document id: columns).
